title: Is cryptocurrency the future of finance?
description: The debate evaluates whether cryptocurrencies and related blockchain systems will become a central part of the future financial system.

facts.fact: India ranked first among 151 countries in Chainalysis's 2024 Global Crypto Adoption Index.
India led global crypto adoption for a second consecutive year despite stringent regulation and high trading taxes.
Blockchain-based systems can enable peer-to-peer digital value transfer without a traditional central intermediary.
Cryptocurrency prices can be highly volatile, creating risks for savers, investors and payment users.
India taxes income from virtual digital assets at 30%, plus applicable surcharge and cess, with restricted loss offsets.
The Reserve Bank of India has repeatedly warned that private cryptocurrencies can pose risks to financial stability and consumer protection.
